data_fields.name: loss_band_upto
data_fields.donor_constant: 2, 6, 8, 10 (Quebec: beaver lost, safe, all lost, fox lost; New York: end run, safe, all lost, halve)

best_idea: Apply one banded roll per trip to what the player carries (nothing, lose one type, lose all, or halve a type's price), in the order roll, then cost, then payout, and write it once on the server.
decision_why: A cumulative band roll on carried stock is a clear, testable loss rule that can sit in zone data and serve a death or zone-exit penalty on the bag; adapt because the donor is a trade game with a run-ending band that does not fit a fight game, and it carries five defects (a cost mismatch, a halved-type message mismatch, missing cent floor, a stale New York price, and a closed random range) that the port must fix.
acceptance: On a zone exit with a loss table of 20 percent lose-one-type, 20 percent lose-all and 60 percent nothing: a player carrying 40 mink, 30 beaver, 20 ermine and 10 fox sees a results card with one line per type and the lost type named; a server test asserts the purse change equals the surviving stock times price minus the zone cost, the carried total never exceeds 190, and the roll never reaches an out-of-table value.
